breve: A visual shader node that makes particles emitted in a shape defined by a Mesh.
descricao: VisualShaderNodeParticleEmitter that makes the particles emitted in a shape of the assigned 'mesh'. It will emit from the mesh's surfaces, either all or only the specified one.

propriedades.desc: The Mesh that defines emission shape.
Index of the surface that emits particles. 'use_all_surfaces' must be false for this to take effect.
If true, the particles will emit from all surfaces of the mesh.
